transcript: Speaker A: Mr. Shrishanth, straight-a sollanum, mudhalla neenga dhaan English kathukkanum. Appo dhaan paiyan English medium-la nalla perform panna mudiyum. Veetla neenga Tamil pesina, avan eppadi English kathuppan? [Mr. Shrishanth, to be straight, first you need to learn English. Only then can your son perform well in English medium. If you speak Tamil at home, how will he learn English?] Speaker B: Madam, enakke English pesa theriyadhu. Appo naan eppadi avanukku kathu kuduppen? [Madam, I don't even know how to speak English. Then how will I teach him?] Speaker A: Ippo laam English kathukuradhu rombave easy. Adhanaala dhaan naan unga maari parents-ku SpeakX app-a suggest panren. [Now learning English is very easy. That's why I suggest the SpeakX app to parents like you.] Speaker B: SpeakX app-aa? [SpeakX app?] Speaker A: Idhula AI teacher irukkaanga. Avanga ungalukku English pesa kathu kuduppaanga. Veetula free-aa irukkumbodhu, illa office-la irukkumbodhu oru 15 minutes practice pannunga, podhum. Neenga yedhaavadhu thappa pesuna udane correct panniduvaanga. Ennoda student-oda amma kooda 15 days back dhaan practice start pannaanga. Ippo avanga pasangalukku English kathu kudukkuraanga, enkitta kooda confident-aa English pesuraanga. [There is an AI teacher in this. They will teach you to speak English. When you are free at home, or at the office, just practice for 15 minutes, that's enough. If you speak anything wrong, they will correct it immediately. Even my student's mother started practicing just 15 days ago. Now she is teaching English to her kids, and even speaking English confidently with me.] Speaker B: Correct madam, naan English kathukittaadhaan en magan Rohan-um nallaa English pesuvaan. [Correct madam, only if I learn English will my son Rohan also speak English well.] Speaker A: Kandippa 15 days kudunga, unga English fluent aayidum. [Definitely give it 15 days, your English will become fluent.] Speaker B: Indha AI teacher-ku evvalavu selavu? [How much does this AI teacher cost?] Speaker A: Just 2 rupees-ku 7 days trial irukku. Innikke download pannunga. [There is a 7-day trial for just 2 rupees. Download today.]
